text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy, the "Big Bang"— that 
"X-Day." Let's go stargazing for "THRF"...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm the Big Bang...? Um... does this 
have something to do with stargazing...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"MISM"... There is a "Gliese" sky. 
Something isomorphic to "that book"... I 
want to "show" it.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um... do you mean there's a sky you want 
to show me...? I wonder what it could 
be...!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Occultation of Venus"— It's equivalent to 
the panorama in *that book*. I've already 
confirmed the "observable" coordinates.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
An occultation of Venus... Wait, huh?! 
Could that be from that fantasy novel 
scene I told you about the other day, 
Uni-san?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Could it be... we get to see the exact 
same thing...?!?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. I want to give you... a 
"present."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...! I'd love to go see it! Ehehe... Thank 
you, Uni-san.
